853:t_98:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, as a bonus prize, I'll present you with a slightly naughty photo book.」

853:t_98:6.en:
$$アマタ$$
「I saw that coming. So today I put even heavier weights on my feet than usual, so I wouldn't float.」

853:t_98:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In that case, please enjoy it to your heart's content.」

853:t_98:10.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Th-this is bad...! If $$ミコノ$$ sees me in a place like this!」

853:t_98:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Getting so rattled by a mere bluff like this that you float up... You still need more training.」

853:t_99:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$カイエン$$!」

853:t_99:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're openly wary of me. Did you foresee something?」

853:t_99:6.en:
$$カイエン$$
「No need. Your very existence is already an ill omen.」

853:t_99:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I only meant to congratulate Mr. $$カイエン$$, and this is the treatment I get...」

853:t_99:10.en:
$$カイエン$$
「S-sorry, AG. It was my fault.」

853:t_99:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「For all your grumbling, you can't leave people in trouble alone. That big-brother streak is Mr. $$カイエン$$'s good side.」

853:t_99:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, just for today, may I call you 'Big Brother'?」

853:t_99:13.en:
$$カイエン$$
「I knew it. You can't be trusted for a second!」

853:t_100:4.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「Th-thank you, AG... But don't come any closer.」

853:t_100:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Eeeh~ why~? I only want to congratulate Miss $$ミコノ$$~」

853:t_100:6.en:
$$ミコノ$$
(S-scary... But I can't stay frightened forever...!)

853:t_100:7.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「That's enough, AG! If you try to do anything more lewd, I'll get angry too!」

853:t_100:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Muha~! A beautiful girl's anger, the best! Thanks for the treat!」

853:t_100:9.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I-I knew it, this is no good~!」

853:t_101:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$アンディ$$!」

853:t_101:4.en:
$$アンディ$$
「After years and years of hard struggle digging holes! I feel like I've finally come out of a long tunnel!」

853:t_101:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What hardship...? You're getting cozy with Miss $$ＭＩＸ$$, so please put up with a little trouble.」

853:t_101:6.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Yeah! For $$ＭＩＸ$$'s sake, I'll endure any hardship!」

853:t_101:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then please give Miss $$ＭＩＸ$$ to me. I'll definitely make her happy.」

853:t_101:8.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Like I could do that!」

853:t_101:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What are you saying? Mr. $$アンディ$$, you just said that for Miss $$ＭＩＸ$$'s sake, you could endure any hardship, didn't you?」

853:t_101:10.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Uh... ah... I-I did say that, but...」

853:t_101:11.en:
$$アンディ$$
「Handing over $$ＭＩＸ$$ for $$ＭＩＸ$$'s sake... But that's... no... it's for $$ＭＩＸ$$'s sake, so I have to endure...」

853:t_101:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes... you've fallen into the hole. Mission accomplished.」

853:t_102:4.en:
$$モロイ$$
「I can do this much too when I try. Believe it or not, at $$聖天使学園$$ I'm known as a hidden powerhouse.」

853:t_102:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good for you. That you didn't end up as a secret weapon that stayed secret.」

853:t_102:6.en:
$$モロイ$$
「What are you saying, AG! Once people recognize my ability, I can be this active!」

853:t_102:7.en:
$$モロイ$$
「In other words, it's strange NOT to use me, and the fact that I'm buried is the higher-ups' responsibility. The only way to break through this situation is structural reform.」

853:t_102:8.en:
$$モロイ$$
「To that end, I'll stand at the head of the reform...」

853:t_102:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I'd forgotten... that Mr. $$モロイ$$ is also a hot-blooded man of the tropics...)

853:t_103:4.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Oh, AG. Like always, you give off a strange smell.」

853:t_103:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You say 'Silvie this, $$シルフィ$$ that' with your mouth, but the one your instincts crave is this AG here.」

853:t_103:8.en:
$$カグラ$$
「I-it's a lie...! Don't talk nonsense!!」

853:t_103:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now... let us love each other by instinct, across the span of 12,000 years.」

853:t_104:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand, Mr. $$ジン$$. You'd rather have Miss $$ユノハ$$'s blessing kiss than a congratulation from a robot like this, right?」

853:t_104:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Honest, very good. But especially the first time, a man needs to take the lead.」

853:t_104:8.en:
$$ジン$$
「Even if you say that, I...」

853:t_104:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's fine! This AG will give you a lecture, so let's practice here.」

853:t_104:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! First, the basics of the basics: with your eyes closed, gauge the distance to your partner.」

853:t_104:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(He really is an honest one. If Miss $$ユノハ$$ saw this scene of him trying to kiss me, it'd be far worse than going invisible. It'd be instant annihilation, I'd say...)

853:t_105:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait a moment, please! The celebration ritual is still left!」

853:t_105:6.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Because you're going to use the celebration as an excuse to come up with some sexual harassment, right?」

853:t_105:8.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I knew it! Indecency gets the iron fist!」

853:t_105:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you very much! This is what I was waiting for!」

853:t_105:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah~ Miss $$ゼシカ$$'s impact is the best!」

853:t_105:11.en:
$$ゼシカ$$
「N-noooo! The range of the sexual harassment is expanding!!」

853:t_106:4.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Thank you, AG. You're the one who's always working hard.」

853:t_106:6.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Thanks to $$アンディ$$, I've come to understand men a little bit.」

853:t_106:7.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Seeking out women to heal a heart tired from the days of battle... AG... you're tired too, aren't you.」

853:t_106:9.en:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Come here. If I'm good enough for you, I'll heal you, AG.」
